name: accessible-home-plan
description: Measure routes, turning space and reach.

interface.longDescription: Measure routes, turning space and reach. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Check gaps between positioned furniture; Check a supplied clear turning circle; Compare storage to personal reach limits. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me check gaps between positioned furniture.
Help me check a supplied clear turning circle.
